title: What happens when AI agents start paying each other? Watch Mastercard Agent Pay for Machines in action
notes: News brief dated 2026-10-20 (Cloudflare Connect). Opens Agent Pay for Machines Early Access (first version of buyer- and seller-side APIs, toolkit, sandbox and developer documentation) after end-to-end pilots with Cloudflare, Ant International, AIsa, Base, BVNK, Coinbase and Hype. Says AP4M builds on x402; describes signed off-chain payment vouchers that providers can combine and redeem later, Coinbase Developer Platform wallet infrastructure, Base as the settlement network, and BVNK as the agent wallet using Mastercard Global Money Platform. Names no Tempo, Stripe or MPP. mastercard.com refuses curl; the page was read on 2026-10-21 in a headed Chrome session.
